memories.content: ABC News/Washington Post is a major national polling organization. It can conduct and release head-to-head surveys. It has no pre-existing commitment to release a survey in the first week of October 2012.

The 2012 U.S. presidential election is between incumbent Barack Obama and challenger Mitt Romney. Major national polling organizations regularly conduct and publicly release head-to-head surveys. The first week of October 2012 runs from Monday October 1 to Sunday October 7. The hard cutoff for resolution is 21:00 EDT on Monday October 8, 2012.
